messages:
Ash: Quick heads-up — planned blog + benchmark publish scheduled for TOMORROW 9:00am PT (embargo until 9:00am PT). Need final press list, approved social copy, assets in CDN, and someone owning press replies. CC @Lee @Priya @Noah

Lee: Got it. I'll own press replies. Press list here: https://drive.redwood/presslist_v5 (please DM if you need reporter contact details). I'll ping top-tier reporters 30m before embargo lifts.

Priya: Draft social copy below — two short variants. Please approve or edit by EOD so I can schedule posts: 
Variant A: "Today we’re launching Redwood Optimize — better latency, lower inference costs. Read our benchmark & methods: <link>"
Variant B: "New at Redwood: production-first inference optimizations. Benchmarks & guide: <link>"
Also need final hero image and OG meta.

Noah: Legal reviewed the methods section and cleared language, but we need one small data-point clarified in the benchmark appendix (latency percentile for 99.9th). Can eng confirm the exact datapoint we plan to publish?

Sam: I'll run the final benchmark today at 5:00pm PT and post results. Running script: `./bench/run --suite=release --seed=42 --save=bench-final.json`. If results look good, we flip the badge.

Ash: Can someone own the launch channel during publish window? Ideally @Lee for press; @Priya for social scheduling; @Sam for infra/runbook; I'll coordinate comms with execs.

Lee: I can own press. For embargo breaches — who will be the fallback contact to escalate to Legal/CEO?

Priya: I'll queue the posts and monitor responses for first hour. Need sign-off on copy + OG image by 6pm PT.

Sam: I'll be on the 8:30am runbook call and the 8:50am quick-check for infra. Ops playbook snippets: 
```
# runbook checklist (short)
- confirm CDN has /assets/hero.jpg
- check bench-final.json for 99.9p latency
- start publish job: jobs.trigger(job-1995032468)
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled publish job created: job-1995032468 — triggers 2025-06-15 09:00:00 PT. Notifying: @Ash @Lee @Priya @Sam.

Ash: :thumbsup: Final checklist for tonight: legal ✅ (Noah), bench ✅ (Sam running at 5pm), assets in CDN ✅ (Sam + design), CEO quote ✅ (Jen). If any blockers by 6pm PT call it out here.

Jen: Happy to provide a one-line quote for the blog. Draft: "We’re excited to share our latest inference advances — faster, cheaper, and built for production." Approve and we’ll include it in the post.

Lee: Approved from PR side. I'll prep a short Q&A for reporters and the standard embargo statement.

Ash: Thanks team — see you on the 8:30am runbook. If anything changes I'll update this thread. :rocket:
